prompt:
Use the connected stitch MCP server to design and build the complete VibeShift: Instant Persona and Communication Transformer web application from start to finish. Follow these exact steps in order:

### STEP 1: GENERATE THE UI IN STITCH VIA MCP
1. Call create_project on the Stitch MCP server to create a new project named VibeShift.
2. Call generate_screen_from_text (using GEMINI_3_PRO or GEMINI_3_FLASH for desktop/web) with the following UI prompt:
   Design a sleek dark-mode SaaS desktop dashboard called VibeShift (#0B0F19 background, #111827 surface cards, #6366F1 indigo accent, Inter & JetBrains Mono fonts). Top header with VibeShift logo and a green Live AI Ready badge. Split-screen layout: Left column (38% width) has Raw Draft Input Studio with 3 sample scenario chips ('Prod Server Crash', 'Scope Creep Pushback', 'Blunt Code Review'), a large multi-line textarea with word/character counter, tone sliders (Formality, Warmth, Urgency), and a primary indigo CTA button Transform Across All Personas. Right column (62% width) has a 2x2 grid of Persona Output Cards: 1) Executive C-Level Summary (Amber badge), 2) Supportive Peer Feedback (Emerald badge), 3) Legal/Compliance Notice (Cyan badge), and 4) Gen-Z Hype (Purple badge). Inside each card: Persona header, Copy button, Show Word Diff toggle switch, main text body showing red strikethrough deletions and green highlighted additions, and a bottom Rewrite Delta analytics bar showing word count change %, vocabulary shift %, horizontal Tone Shift bars (Formality, Empathy, Clarity), and a 100% Core Facts Preserved badge.
3. Once generated, call list_screens and get_screen to fetch the generated Stitch screen layout, HTML/CSS structure, and design tokens, and save the design rules to DESIGN.md.

### STEP 2: BUILD THE WORKING REACT + TAILWIND APP MATCHING THE STITCH SCREEN
Scaffold and build the full React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons web app strictly matching the Stitch screen design retrieved in Step 1:
1. SHARED API KEY CONFIG (ZERO-SETUP FOR PLATFORM VISITORS)
2. MULTI-PERSONA AI TRANSFORMATION
3. DIFF & ANALYTICS ENGINE
### STEP 3: VERIFY & RUN
